Name: Desert Festival Foods (Italian Translation)
Author: Sym0n1203
Description:
[center]✦•······················•✦•······················•✦﻿
[ITALIAN][/center]
[b]IMPORTANTE:[/b] Questo è solo un file di traduzione di (e perciò dipende da) "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21303]Desert Festival Foods[/url]﻿" di Wizadroid. Non può funzionare senza istallare i file della mod originale (che a sua volta non può funzionare senza "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿" di Pathoschild).

[b]TUTORIAL DI ISTALLAZIONE:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Abbi SMAPI installato.
[*]Scarica [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21303?tab=files]la mod originale[/url]﻿﻿ nella sua ultima versione.
[*]Scarica il file traduzione da qui nella sua ultima versione.
[*]Decomprimi la cartella della mod.
[*]Decomprimi il file traduzione [b]it.zip[/b].
[*]Sposta il file decompresso [b]it.json[/b] dentro a [b][CP] Desert Festival Foods\i18n[/b] assieme al file preesistente [b]default.json[/b] (non serve cancellarlo).
[*]Sposta l'intera cartella principale [b][CP] Desert Festival Foods[/b] nella tua cartella [b]Mods[/b] (vedi [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]qui[/url]﻿﻿ se non sai dove sia).
[*]Avvia il gioco e seleziona la lingua italiana.
[/list]
A fini di coerenza, tutti i nomi dei piatti riflettono quelli dalla traduzione italiana originale del gioco (realizzata da Alessio Messersì).

[center]✦•······················•✦•······················•✦
[ENGLISH][/center][b]IMPORTANT[/b]: This is solely a translation file of (and thus depends on) "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21303]Desert Festival Foods[/url]" by Wizadroid. It cannot work without installing the orignal mod files (which in turn cannot work without "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿" by Pathoschild).

[b]INSTALLATION TUTORIAL:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Have SMAPI installed.
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21303?tab=files]the original mod[/url]﻿ in its latest version.
[*]Download the translation file from here in its latest version.
[*]Unzip the mod folder.
[*]Unzip the translation file [b]it.zip[/b].
[*]Move the unzipped [b]it.json[/b] file into [b][CP] Desert Festival Foods\i18n[/b] along with the pre-existing [b]default.json[/b] file (you don't need to delete it).
[*]Move the whole main folder [b][CP] Desert Festival Foods[/b] into your [b]Mods[/b] folder (see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]here[/url]﻿ if you can't find that).
[*]Start the game and select Italian language.
[/list]
For consistency, all the names of the food objects reflect the ones from the original in-game Italian translations (done by Alessio Messersì).
